answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 4845 Country: India Title: As black dye is haram is the dye of other colour can be applied. Question: As black dye is haram is the dye of other colour can be applied. Answer ID: 4845 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 455/455=M/1429) Yes, one can apply dye other than black provided it is not impure and any agent other than colour. However, it is better to apply henna and kusum . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
